annotations.target_phrase: I guess it’s just the way I’m wired
annotations.annotation_text: Molly's signature self-characterization, articulating the somatic and psychological reconfiguration of human nature through military cybernetic augmentation.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 29.

annotations.target_phrase: ten double-edged, four-centimeter scalpel blades slid from their housings beneath the burgundy nails
annotations.annotation_text: The somatic weaponization of the female body. Molly's retractable fingertip scalpels subvert conventional domestic or decorative femininity (burgundy nail polish) into lethal tactical weaponry.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 29.
Sponsler, Claire. 'Cyberpunk and the Dilemmas of Postmodern Subjectivity.' (1992).
